invalid_id: id: lowercase letters, digits, . _ -, starting with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters
ssh_unsupported: SSH computers can no longer be added. Install the node service on that computer and choose “Computer connects” or “Hub connects”. SSH computers already in hub.json keep working
exists: There’s already a computer with this id
invalid_name: The name can be at most 40 characters, on one line
keeps_machines: This assistant keeps computers in its own list. Move them to another assistant before removing it
default_machine: This is the hub’s own default computer, which comes back at every start. To remove it, set "machines": [] in hub.json and restart the hub
